rules.description: PDCF canonical domain; preserve local save recovery and its dependencies
rules.expression: (http.host eq "pdcf.aaronfaby.com" and not (http.request.uri.path in {"/assets/transfer.html" "/engine.mjs" "/style.css" "/robots.txt"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/runtime/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/fonts/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/")))

rules.description: PDCF canonical domain; preserve local save recovery and its dependencies
rules.expression: ((http.host eq "www.pdcf.dev" and not (http.request.uri.path in {"/assets/transfer.html" "/engine.mjs" "/style.css" "/robots.txt"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/runtime/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/fonts/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/cdn-cgi/"))) or (http.host eq "pdcf.dev" and http.request.scheme eq "http"))
